decks.notes: This Dimir Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures and removal spells. The main focus of this UW Control deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, life gain, card draw, and removal spells. By using cards like Flashfreeze and Ride's End to counter opponent's spells, along with Authority of the Consuls to gain life and slow down aggro decks, the deck aims to outlast opponents and grind out a victory. The deck also includes creatures like Phyrexian Vindicator and Beza, the Bounding Spring for added threats and win conditions, while utilizing lands like Fabled Passage and Seachrome Coast for mana fixing.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using cards like Llanowar Elves and Wastewood Verge, in order to bring out powerful creatures like Mosswood Dreadknight and Archfiend of the Dross. With removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down, as well as disruption cards like Unholy Annex and Gix's Command, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggression and control. The deck also includes cards like Soulstone Sanctuary and Preacher of the Schism for added staying power and synergy within the Golgari color identity.
